extraction.scope: Assetel at Astral Plaza in Zapopan
extraction.award_date_role: EPI Issued Date and TIA Awarded date
extraction.project_scope_review: The award verifies the built physical condition only at the scope named by the certifier.

constructed_facility_award.certified_scope: Assetel at Astral Plaza in Zapopan
constructed_facility_award.assessment_review: The TIA scheme requires on-site assessment of the completed facility and year-three recertification. EPI’s brochure page 5 distinguishes physical inspection from annual surveillance, which can rely on remote validation or self-declaration. The renewed signed certificate states the identified constructed property was independently assessed, and the native TIA record gives the award day. The actual day of the inspection was not published.
constructed_facility_award.identity_review: EPI and TIA identify the Assetel facility at Astral Plaza in Zapopan. The project concerns only the data center within the shared building.

sources.date_semantics: The issuer identifies the effective issue date of its renewed constructed-facility certification. This records the completed condition at renewal. It does not date the original construction, audit visit or start of service.
